svg.title: Space Drums pipeline
svg.desc: Animated data-flow diagram: capture, hands, stick, tracking, features, prediction, geometry, commit and audio, each producing one record type; a light packet travels the whole chain.
svg.text: DATA FLOW · ONE RECORD TYPE PER STAGE
Every record carries the t_capture of the frame it came
Components consume only observations with timestamp ≤
Arms A, B and C share the same geometry and commit code
